contexts.text: Man is so conjoined... with those who are outside of him that...
Outside of good were such things as it could not agree with... But after regeneration... good... inflows into those things which are outside.
(All man's thought and affection is from causes outside of him.)
Believed those outside their society to be dead...
Evil comes forth outside the Divine...
So long as good and truth are outside the will... they are outside the man; for the understanding is without, and the will is within. DP 233:7. DP 318:11.
The things of truth in act outside the Church. Signified.
The quality of the good of truth of those who are outside the Church. Signified, Explained.
What is around and outside is general relatively to that which is in the middle or within.
Man regards the things which... do not reign universally as outside himself, and also as below himself.
Relatively to goods, (Knowledges) are outside the man himself.
When man is in a state of truth, he is outside of Heaven...
What it is to be outside the External, and not within. Signified, Explained.
For the things which are without the Angels receive an appearance according to the things within them.
The things outside their houses correspond to the truths which are from good, and also to perceptions.
Whether in the body or out of the body.
I was then in the spirit outside the body.
When the celestial hear rational things, they see them outside of themselves; thus from others; and not within themselves, as do the spiritual.
That which is below, is also outside...

That which enters into the understanding with a man whose will is in evil, is not within, but without him: it is only in the memory... and that which is outside a man, and not in his life, disappears by little and little...
God 3. 13. It is vain to think of what... is outside the world; because... outside the world there is no space.
God. 8. 11. Evils are not taken away... because they are outside the subjects, and outside created things...
